messages.context: Jerry 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.
messages.text: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.
messages.zh: 你的 SkyBlock 岛屿只是广阔世界的一部分。

messages.context: Jerry 新手流程实测台词（第 2 条）
messages.raw: The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!
messages.text: The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!
messages.zh: SkyBlock 世界中有无数岛屿等你探索,也有各种资源等你发现!

messages.context: Jerry 新手流程实测台词（第 3 条）
messages.raw: Use the §5Portal §fto warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!
messages.text: Use the Portal to warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!
messages.zh: 使用传送门前往其中的第一座岛屿——SkyBlock 中心岛!

segments.text: to warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!
segments.zh: 前往其中的第一座岛屿——SkyBlock 中心岛!

messages.text: It's the holiday season in SkyBlock and that can only mean one thing...
messages.zh: SkyBlock 的节日季到了,这只意味着一件事……

messages.text: Jerry's Workshop is under attack!
messages.zh: Jerry 的工坊遭到袭击了!

messages.text: Save the Jerrys' home and ensure all of SkyBlock gets to receive Gifts!
messages.zh: 救救 Jerry 们的家园,让整个 SkyBlock 都能收到礼物!

messages.text: Your SkyBlock island is all you have!
messages.zh: 你的 SkyBlock 岛屿就是你的全部!

messages.text: Progress as far as you can by killing mobs, gaining collection, and using minions.
messages.zh: 击杀生物、积累收藏品、使用小人,能走多远走多远。

messages.text: There is no escape...you are stranded!
messages.zh: 无处可逃……你被困在这里了!

messages.text: My expertise doesn't come for free!
messages.zh: 我的专业意见可不是免费的!

messages.text: Villagers tend to have sweet trades!
messages.zh: 村民手里常有划算的交易!

messages.text: Did you know Slimes can spawn near the void?
messages.zh: 你知道吗? 史莱姆会在虚空边上刷出来。

messages.text: Cocoa Beans only grow on one type of tree!
messages.zh: 可可豆只长在一种树上!

messages.text: Shiny creatures can drop shiny things!
messages.zh: 闪亮的生物会掉闪亮的东西!

messages.text: Rabbits can spawn in different biomes!
messages.zh: 兔子会在不同的生物群系里刷出来!

messages.text: I've heard that scary monsters can attack your island sometime in Autumn.
messages.gloss: 这里的 Autumn 是空岛历第 8 个月(惊魂节在 Autumn 29-31 日),按 GLOSSARY 台词里写汉字月份。
messages.zh: 听说到了八月,会有可怕的怪物袭击你的岛。

messages.text: The only way to obtain Emeralds is to trade for them!
messages.zh: 绿宝石只能靠交易换来!

messages.text: Pigmen are great at hoarding wealth.
messages.zh: 猪人最擅长囤财。

messages.text: This place desperately needs more Iron Golems!
messages.zh: 这地方急需更多铁傀儡!

messages.text: In my opinion, Magma Cubes are just fiery slimes.
messages.zh: 要我说,岩浆怪不过是着了火的史莱姆。

messages.text: Villagers tend to have cool trades!
messages.zh: 村民手里常有不错的交易!

messages.text: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... [1/2]
messages.zh: 你的 SkyBlock 岛屿只是广阔世界的一部分…… [1/2]

messages.text: Wait, how did I get here? [2/2]
messages.zh: 等等,我怎么会在这儿? [2/2]

messages.context: Jerry 工坊里的随机台词
messages.text: Jerry.
messages.zh: Jerry。

messages.text: Jerry?
messages.zh: Jerry?

messages.text: Jerry...
messages.zh: Jerry……

messages.text: Jerry!
messages.zh: Jerry!

messages.text: I seem to be having some issues warping you... Check again soon!
messages.zh: 我好像没法把你传送过去……稍后再试试!

messages.context: 送玩家去 Jerry 工坊
messages.text: Thank you for your bravery! Good luck!
messages.zh: 感谢你的勇气! 祝你好运!

messages.text: You are truly a hero! Thank you for helping us!
messages.zh: 你真是个英雄! 谢谢你帮助我们!

messages.text: Off you go! Thanks for the help!
messages.zh: 去吧! 多谢帮忙!

messages.text: I don't talk to guests! Go away!
messages.zh: 我不跟客人说话! 走开!

messages.text: I refuse to speak with guests!
messages.zh: 我拒绝和客人交谈!

messages.text: Leave me alone, guest!
messages.zh: 别烦我,客人!
